# Savour

> Savour (https://savour.page) is a professional recipe management platform (receptbeheer, receptenapp) for chefs, kitchen teams, restaurants and the hospitality industry (horeca). It turns scattered recipes — Word documents, PDFs, photos of handwritten notes — into one organised, searchable recipe library that works on desktop, tablet and phone, and can be shared with the whole kitchen brigade. Made by chefs from the Netherlands, for chefs. Its core idea: turning coffee-stained handwritten notes and old recipe notebooks into recipes that are right.

Savour is built for professional kitchens, especially fine dining. Two audiences: chefs (head chefs, sous-chefs, pastry chefs) and kitchen brigades. It is not a consumer recipe site; it is a tool to manage a kitchen's own recipes.

## Core values

1. **Organising recipes** (recepten organiseren): one recipe book with folders, categories, A–Z and full-text search across titles, ingredients and methods.
2. **Recipe management for kitchen brigades** (receptenmanagement voor brigades): shared folders where the head chef manages, the sous-chef edits and the rest of the brigade reads, all from the same version.
3. **A recipe database on every device, online and offline**: desktop, tablet and phone; installable on the home screen without an app store; the library opens without internet (read-only until back online).
4. **A recipe archive online and offline**: old menus and past seasons stay searchable in archive folders; recipes are never deleted when Pro stops.
5. **Everything stored in the cloud**: recipes are stored securely per account; a new phone or laptop only means logging in again. Pro users can download everything as Word files or a backup.
6. **AI import for messy notes and messy folders**: the free Savour reader splits large Word/PDF files into separate recipes; AI (Savour Pro) reads handwritten notes and re-reads doubtful recipes. It never invents quantities; uncertain items are flagged for review.
7. **Sharing and printing recipes**: share a single recipe by link (with optional time limit) or a whole folder with your team; print single recipe cards.
8. **Printing complete recipe folders**: a whole folder at once, with table of contents, in A4 or A5, with your restaurant's logo on Savour Pro.

## What Savour does

- **Import a whole recipe book at once**: Word (.docx), PDF and text files are read by the built-in Savour reader for free. A chef imported 1,400 recipes from Word in about 2 minutes.
- **AI for difficult sources (Savour Pro)**: photos of handwritten notes, scanned pages and messy documents are read by AI. The AI never invents quantities, ingredients or steps; unclear recipes are flagged for review.
- **Import from a website or another recipe app**: paste the link to a recipe page (schema.org recipes are read directly), or import exports from Paprika (.paprikarecipes), Mealie, Tandoor, Recipe Keeper, Copy Me That, Crouton (.crumb), MasterCook (.mx2, .mxp), Plan to Eat (.csv) and any schema.org JSON or HTML.
- **Unit-aware scaling**: scaling understands units (tsp, tbsp, cup, g, kg, ml, l, oz, lb, Dutch el/tl), converts within a family (20 tsp → 6 ⅔ tbsp), shows spoons and cups as clean fractions and grams as whole numbers; one-tap ½×, 2×, 3×, 4× also works without a yield.
- **Organise**: folders, categories, A–Z index, favourites and full-text search across titles, ingredients and methods.
- **Use in the kitchen**: scale any recipe to the yield you need, cook mode with large text on a phone or tablet, print single recipe cards or a whole folder at once (A4 or A5, with your restaurant's logo on Savour Pro).
- **Works offline**: install Savour on the home screen (no app store needed); the recipe library opens without internet, for example in a walk-in or basement.
- **Collaborate**: shared folders with roles — owner (manages), editor (adds and edits), viewer (reads) — so the whole brigade works from the same recipes.
- **Languages**: the app and the website are available in Dutch, English, German and Spanish.

## Pricing

- **Free**: up to 100 recipes, Savour reader import (Word, PDF, text), member of other people's shared folders.
- **Savour Pro**: €2.99 per month or €29 per year — unlimited recipes, AI import (up to 500 per month), create shared folders and invite your team.
- **Team plans**: 5 people €8.99/month, 10 people €14.99/month, 25 people €29.99/month (or yearly). Everyone on the team gets Pro.
- New accounts can try Savour Pro free for 7 days, no payment details needed (up to 100 recipes during the trial).
- Stopping Pro never deletes recipes; everything stays available.
